title: Vylet Pony Music Discs
description: Adds a selection of Vylet Pony's songs to Minecraft in the form of music discs!
body:
Fairly simple mod that adds 40 music discs (so far), with songs made by the pony musician Vylet Pony :3

Some Discs have recipes, those that don't, will!


Songs Included so far -
